title: Rivian buys world model startup to accelerate self-driving ambitions | TechCrunch
summary: Third Dimension’s technology uses AI to match the physical world, which when combined with Rivian’s reams of data could turn into a valuable simulator. Rivian uses that data, which is aggregated and anonymized, to build training models for driving.
